title: The keys stayed outside the marked floor
body: The keyring is wrapped in the lunchbox's cloth lining. A chalk boundary crosses the lid; the ring is on the clean side and the meal on the dusty one.
rival_reading: A warehouse crew could separate access keys from stored supplies during a routine safety check; the chalk line may have nothing to do with evacuation.
gloss: A boundary separates the keys from the meal they travelled with.

title: The notebook used as a bucket lid
body: The notebook has been laid over the bucket. A green crescent marks the page where it touched the rim; the rest of the page is blank except for a pressed grass stem.
rival_reading: A cleanup crew could use a bucket and notebook while inspecting any spill; plant residue does not identify a pesticide or its route.
gloss: A plant trace remains where a notebook covered a bucket.
